'''Capperling's Cantina''' was located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]]'s [[Dankcamp Village]]. The [[Storm-hair]] known as "[[Ranquiv]]," and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]<ref name="Choices" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="ChoicesD">''[[Choices of One]]'' takes place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref>
